items.description: Whitman Publishing Company Washington Head Quarter Collection album Number Three, starting 1960. The album contains a partial set of Washington quarters spanning dates from 1960 through 1968, including Philadelphia and Denver mint issues. Coins present include 1960, 1960-D, 1961, 1961-D, 1962, 1962-D, 1963, 1963-D, 1964, 1964-D, 1965, 1966, 1967, and 1968 issues, with several slots remaining empty. The blue Whitman folder (No. 9040) is designed by John Flanagan and notes mint quantities below each opening.

items.ai_notes: [Mercury Dime collection album] Value is primarily in the silver content of the coins present.
items.category: Antiques and Collectibles > Coins, Currency, Precious Metals
items.description: A Whitman Publishing Company Mercury Head Dime collection album (No. 9014) spanning 1916 to 1945, featuring a large number of silver Mercury dimes housed in the original blue coin folder. The collection includes coins from Philadelphia, Denver (D), and San Francisco (S) mint marks across the full run of the series. Designed by A.A. Weinman, the coins depict Liberty with winged cap. Several slots are filled throughout the album including many mid-series and late-series dates. Some slots remain empty. Mint quantities are noted below each slot in the album.
